name: @flyee/rules
description: The pure rules of ONE's domain: no I/O, no clock of its own, no framework. The validators of M2 (the unique case number of the CNJ, flight numbers and airport codes, registrations at the bar, a person's age on a date), and since S6 the forum, the kind of proceeding, the reading of a METAR, the Tema 1.417 triage and the count of causes per state, and since S9 the deadline of a procedural act over the court's calendar; prescription joins in M4.
